title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for personal finance, will let you connect bank accounts
summary: OpenAI is launching ChatGPT for personal finance, enabling users to connect their bank accounts for a dashboard of portfolio performance, spending, subscriptions, and upcoming payments. This move expands ChatGPT's utility beyond general knowledge and creative tasks into practical financial management.
charlotte_impact: This development has the potential to disrupt the fintech industry by providing users with a more conversational and integrated personal finance experience. Banks and financial institutions will need to adapt their offerings to compete with AI-powered solutions like ChatGPT, possibly leading to partnerships or acquisitions to stay relevant.

title: The OpenAI trial wraps up, and the Musk founder machine keeps spinning
